profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ General Motors | UI/UX
profile.summary:
With over 14 years of experience as a software engineer, I am passionate about creating user-friendly, responsive, and scalable web applications that enhance customer experience and satisfaction. I have extensive knowledge and skills in front-end and back-end technologies, including React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, jQuery, and AJAX, C#, JAVA, SQL, MySQL

Currently, I work as a senior UI/UX engineer at General Motors, where I collaborate with a cross-functional team of developers, designers, and product managers to deliver innovative and high-quality web solutions for various GM products and services. I also conduct research, develop prototypes, implement code, and perform testing and debugging to ensure optimal performance and usability. My goal is to bridge technologies and design, and to contribute to GM's digital transformation and customer loyalty.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Front End
positions.description:
Led the frontend development and launch of a highly responsive B2B application, Parts Workbench Plus, using React with Typescript to enhance user experience and interface efficiency.
Collaborated closely with product owners and UX/UI designers to translate business requirements into compelling user-facing features.
Architected and implemented reusable front-end systems and components for GM Customer Care and Aftersales, reducing code redundancy and improving application scalability and maintainability.
Mentored a team of junior and mid-level front-end developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

positions.title: Senior UI/UX Engineer
positions.description:
Working closely with our application architect I helped plan the front-end architecture and then spearheaded the UI development for GM's primary parts ordering application which is used by 10,000+ auto parts resellers worldwide. I have been working closely with our business partners and designers to implement a redesigned user experience using Reactjs, NodeJs, Typescript and PostgresSql. Additionally we have been improving deployment practices to achieve a highly responsive deployment cycle. 

Recipient of the GM CIO Excellence in Technology 2022 team award for using Agile Development and CI/CD practices to rapidly develop and release new features, improving app stability and customer adoption.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead Front-End Engineer overseeing the advancement of a cutting-edge automotive parts e-commerce platform, catering to 1,600+ automotive dealerships and facilitating the transactions of over 1 billion auto parts. Key responsibilities encompassed crafting RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js, constructing reusable components using a combination of PHP/HTML + JS and React.js, and integrating secure and efficient PayPal and Stripe e-commerce payment solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Performance · HTML · MySQL · JavaScript · Express.js · Web Applications · PHP · Scrum · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Redux.js · Project Planning · SEO · jQuery · HTML 5 · Semantic UI · Node.js · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · CSS · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · User Interface Design · React.js · SASS · Git · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Senior User Interface Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer with expertise in UI/UX development, recognized for spearheading the insourcing and modernization of critical marketing and sales tools at GM. Responsible for end-to-end delivery of core GM applications, including developing code, enhancing integration, and refining delivery practices. Also responsible for mentoring junior developers to foster a collaborative and innovative team culture.

Accomplishments include:
Led a team of developers to rebuild  a complex but critical internal marketing and operations tool using Angular, Material UI and Java/SpringBoot.

Lead Software Engineer responsible for developing the UI for global e-commerce vehicle shopping platform: `Shop Click Drive`. Led the development and internationalization efforts to successfully release to four major markets. Rebuilt the UI from an XML/JAVA stack to a .NET/C# HTML5/JavaScript application.

Revamped and enhanced the user experience of the GM Canada online credit application by utilizing Adobe Photoshop, Balsamiq wireframes, and rapid prototypes to create a new design and rebuilt the app using custom JavaScript Web Components, HTML5 and jQuery.

Developed front-end for a prototype `interactive vehicle configuration`, a large-format touchscreen kiosk application, using JavaScript SPA frameworks: Knockooutjs, Durandal and Breezejs.
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap (Framework) · HTML · TypeScript · JavaScript · Web Applications · I18n · Adobe Dynamic Tag Management (DTM) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Web Components · Durandaljs · LESS (Stylesheet Language) · Angular · Java · ASP.NET MVC · XHTML · jQuery · HTML 5 · SQL · CSS · User Interface Design · jQuery Mobile · SASS · Breeze.js · TFS · KnockoutJS · Material UI · Git · C#

positions.title: Digital Marketing Director
positions.description: Implemented web-based marketing solutions utilizing PHP, XHTML, JavaScript, and MySQL. My primary focus was enhancing e-commerce websites and intranet software. Additionally, developed customized e-learning courses using Adobe Captivate, Audition, and Photoshop, including the creation of video assets and recording/editing all voice-over content.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Design · Web Development · MySQL · JavaScript · Web Applications · Dreamweaver · PHP · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · LESS (Stylesheet Language) · XHTML · SEO · jQuery · SQL · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · CSS · Flash · User Interface Design

positions.title: Owner/Creator/Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Working as a Freelance web developer I designed and built bespoke marketing websites using PHP and XHTML, and implemented templated sites using WordPress, Drupal and Joomla.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Design · Wordpress · Web Development · JavaScript · Dreamweaver · Flash

positions.title: Cavalry Scout
positions.locationName: Fort Hood, TX, Baghdad, Iraq · On-site
positions.description:
Executed reconnaissance and surveillance missions as a 19D Cavalry Scout in the U.S. Army, utilizing advanced equipment and techniques to gather critical information and provide real-time intelligence to commanders.

Deployed to Iraqi in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom 2006-08.
